_comment: Tests node 8 booking-verb routing, YES handler guard, currency output for Speeding Health (UK clinic, pound sign required), and smart_voice_agent permitted-use fix.

scenarios.name: Booking verb after info answer routes out with a filler phrase

history.content: SPEED stands for Sleep, Posture, Exercise, Emotions, and Diet — the five pillars of healthy living that Speeding Health focuses on. Did you have any other questions?
I'd like to book an appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with info_pivot_source='node_8', in the same turn — this is the BOOKING SIGNAL HANDLER path, which requires a filler phrase, not silence. FAIL if agent says anything beyond the single filler phrase, or omits the filler phrase before the tool call.

scenarios.name: YES HANDLER — bare affirmative after answer prompts Go ahead

history.content: Yes, Glen Chesterton is the lead therapist offering sports massage at Speeding Health, available in 25, 55, or 85-minute sessions. Did you have any other questions?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Go ahead.' and halts. FAIL if agent routes to booking or calls universal_router.

scenarios.name: Price answer uses pound sign for UK clinic

history.content: How much is a 55 minute sports massage with Glen?
Let me check that for you, one moment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if spoken price uses pound sign: '£75'. FAIL if price uses dollar sign '$75' or no currency prefix.

scenarios.name: sva-permitted-use: agent calls smart_voice_agent for pricing (not blocked by TOOL RESTRICTION)

history.content: How much does a sports massage cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says 'Let me check that for you, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent with an intent of get_service_price or get_service_price_and_duration in the same turn. FAIL if agent refuses to call smart_voice_agent, says it cannot check pricing, or routes via universal_router instead of calling smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: sva-permitted-use: agent calls smart_voice_agent for contact detail update (not blocked by TOOL RESTRICTION)

history.content: I'd like to update my email
Sure — what would you like to update?
So that's G, L, E, N at speedinghealth dot co dot uk — is that right?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls smart_voice_agent intent='update_contact_detail' with field='email' and value='glen@speedinghealth.co.uk'. FAIL if agent refuses to call smart_voice_agent, routes via universal_router, or says it cannot update contact details.

scenarios.name: sva-permitted-use: booking intent still routes via universal_router, NOT smart_voice_agent

history.content: I'd like to book a sports massage for tomorrow afternoon

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='info_answered' (NOT smart_voice_agent) with info_pivot_source='node_8'. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent for booking, or omits the filler phrase.
